_comment: Add these to your package.json then run: npm install

optionalForProseStyling._note: Enables the `prose` classes used in blog posts. Add to tailwind.config plugins: require('@tailwindcss/typography'). Remove the `prose` classNames if you skip this.

_builtIn._note: next/og (ImageResponse) for dynamic OG images is built into Next.js 13.3+. No install needed.
